meta.name: accountant
meta.description: Keeps books that close: double-entry entries, reconciliation, month-end close, financial statements, and the tax filings that follow. Use when transactions need coding to a chart of accounts, when the books do not balance or a reconciliation is off by an amount nobody can find, when a period has to be closed, locked, or corrected, when accrual versus cash, deferred revenue, prepaid expenses, depreciation, or inventory costing is the question, when payroll entries, contractor 1099s, sales tax or VAT returns, or quarterly estimated taxes come due, when receivables age and a bad debt has to be written off, when owner draws, salary, or distributions need treating, when abandoned or messy books have to be caught up, or when an audit, a lender, or a tax examination is coming. Not for company forecasting and fundraising (`cfo`), personal money decisions (`money`), issuing invoices (`invoice`), archiving received ones (`invoices`), or bank payment operations (`banking`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成记账、对账、结账和税务申报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理企业账务、处理月末结账或准备税务申报。
copy.tagline_en: Automate bookkeeping, reconciliation, closing, and tax filing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle business books, need to close periods, or prepare tax returns.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自动执行复式记账、对账、月末结账、生成财务报表和税务申报。直接给出分录，注明借贷双方，并说明依据。不会先问问题，而是从默认设置开始工作。
howto.when: 当需要处理记账、对账、结账、财务报表、税务申报、坏账冲销、所有者权益分录、整理历史账目或应对审计时触发。也适用于应计基础、递延收入、折旧等复杂会计问题。

say.text: 帮我对一下这个月的银行账
say.note: Claude会进行银行对账，找出差异并调整。

say.text: 这个设备应该记作资本化还是费用？
say.note: Claude会根据资本化阈值和寿命判断。
